description:
1st Board of Directors Meeting – RY 2026–27

The 1st Board of Directors Meeting of the Rotary Club of Mumbai Rising Stars for RY 2026–27 was successfully conducted online via Zoom, with 12 Board members in attendance.

The meeting focused on planning and aligning the Club’s activities for the year ahead, including upcoming projects, fellowships, membership initiatives, administrative matters, and other key Club priorities. The active participation and valuable inputs from the Board members helped set a clear direction for the year.

A productive beginning, reflecting strong teamwork, commitment, and collective leadership for an impactful RY 2026–27.
